    - TestExecBuild/fakedist-disk/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist-spec-planning/geospatial
    
    With explicit casts in this patch, these failures are resolved.
    
    References:
    https://go.dev/ref/spec#Floating_point_operators
    https://github.com/golang/go/issues/53297
    https://github.com/golang/go/issues/48145

### Summary of Changes
- **`ShapeIndex` Serialization** ([shapeindex.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/shapeindex.go)):
  - Added [`Encode(w io.Writer) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/shapeindex.go#L1586-L1603) and [`Decode(r io.Reader) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/shapeindex.go#L1659-L1697).
  - Automatically builds pending index updates during `Encode` so unbuilt indices serialize their full spatial structure, and marks decoded indices as `fresh` so queries and iteration work immediately without `Build()`.
  - Preserves `nextID`, shape IDs (including gaps from removed shapes), `cells`, and `cellMap` (`clippedShape`s with `shapeID`, `containsCenter`, and `edges`).
  - Validates all counts, cell IDs, shape IDs, edge IDs, finite coordinates, and a trailing CRC32 checksum, capping initial slice/map capacities to prevent panics or oversized allocations on truncated or corrupted streams.
  - Fixed [`applyUpdatesInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/shapeindex.go#L842-L872) and [`makeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/shapeindex.go#L1225-L1230) to use `s.nextID` so sparse shape IDs (after `Remove`) are indexed and referenced properly.

  - Added `Encode`/`Decode` and `Shape` fixes for [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/point_vector.go#L49-L103), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/lax_polyline.go#L55-L108), [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/lax_polygon.go#L211-L320), and [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/lax_loop.go#L73-L140), plus [`genericShape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/shape.go#L287-L320) fallback support and safe decoding in [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/polyline.go#L373-L406), [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/loop.go#L1288-L1419), [`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/polygon.go#L1152-L1217), and [`pointcompression.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ki8oahfp/s2/pointcompression.go#L155-L281).
